Package org.aeonbits.owner

Annotation Type Config.Mandatory

Enclosing interface:
Config
@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target({METHOD,TYPE}) @Documented public static @interface Config.Mandatory
Marks a property as mandatory.

Mandatory properties are validated when the Config object is created: if any of them cannot be resolved (from the sources, the imports or a Config.DefaultValue), a MissingMandatoryPropertyException is thrown listing all the missing keys.

The check is also enforced on every access: if a mandatory property becomes unavailable later — for instance after a hot reload or a Mutable.removeProperty(String) — reading it throws a MissingMandatoryPropertyException instead of returning null.

When applied to an interface, all the properties declared in that interface are mandatory - the ones it declares, and no others: an annotation here neither reaches the methods declared by a super-interface nor is inherited by a sub-interface, since an interface governs what it declares. See the documentation, Where an annotation counts. Methods taking parameters cannot be validated at creation time, since the property key may depend on the invocation arguments; for those the check happens on access only.
